## Change

Describe the problem and final behavior.

## Validation

- [ ] `python dev/ci.py` passed on the submitted revision.
- [ ] Manifest and staged diff checked.
- [ ] Latest origin/master included; latest-base PR checks passed.
- [ ] Client checks accepted or explicitly deferred (link evidence; never assume).

## Approval

Owner/reviewer approval of the finished diff and results is required before a
GitHub-only merge. Implementation instructions and green CI are not merge approval.
Release publication requires separate explicit authorization.
